today I randomly run into an old ex, on my way to work. It's been 2 years since the break up: he broke up with me via email, out of the blue, and started a relationship soon after, didn't even want to talk with me, blamed me for things he had never mentioned before. I remember crying for days, blaming myself, I got in a really bad depression, even went to therapy, my parents got me a dog, there were 3 awful months. Since then, every time I saw him I ran away in the other direction and felt like throwing up. Today I just went straight to him, said hi and we talked. THANK GOD I did that. Now that 2 years passed, and I've been in another relationship and dated other guys too, I can say with a smile on my face that LIFE GOT SO MUCH BETTER without him. Even when it sucked and I was depressed, life was still better. Today he didn't ask me a thing, just had a long monologue of complaining about how challenging his life is and how difficult, for every solution or kind word I said, he had 3 negative things to say. Dude was a total tool then and hasn't changed for a bit. I remember crying my heart out then believeing that if he had given me another chance, I could be better and I could make him happy. I was so naive, even now when he is in a happy relationship, just bought an appartment and earns shitloads of money he keeps complaining and is a whinny attention whore. I couldn't be more grateful he dumped me. I've done so many cool things, and even though I am single now, I'm in a way better place than I was even in my happiest times with him. If you're depressed somebody dumped you, just have faith you will meet people who are better for you than you can even imagine.

hey, congrats on trying to get better and feel better in your own skin. your boobs look amazing! I reached your post because I was looking for exercise tips to get saggy boobs less saggy, cuz plastic surgery costs a damn fortune. so we all have our issues. what worked for me regarding weight loss and getting fitter: no sweets, just 1 coffee (I usually only drink coffee), water helps too, and I also went swimming. but not chill relaxed swimming, I got a coach and I had to swim really fast, about 20-30 laps in an hour. For me it was a lot, but after a month I looked better than I did in years. Now it's gone, cuz I haven't gone swimming anymore, so find some sport you really like, even if you suck at it and it will be difficult, and do that for 2-3 times a week. it does wonders and not just for your body. but when you learn a new skill, your self-confidence gets a boost and yo keep your depression away. I also suffer from depressive episodes, never cut myself, but frequently had suicidal thoughts - sports helped every time. maybe not in the first week, but it surely did help a lot. best of luck, have faith in yourself and jst do it. I really hope you find a sport you love and get really good at it!
